data.name: public.home.description
data.value: Run shipments, dispatch, warehouses and billing from one system. Built for courier companies, freight handlers and warehouse teams.

data.name: public.home.headline
data.value: Run shipments, dispatch, warehouses and billing from one system.

data.value: Vixly gives logistics teams one platform to manage shipments, parcels, warehouse work, dispatch, invoices, payments and customer visibility across every location.

data.name: public.home.audience_line
data.value: Built for courier companies, freight handlers, warehouse teams and multi-branch logistics.

data.value: One platform for the work you do every day

data.value: Vixly connects shipment intake, parcel handling, barcode scans, warehouse movement, dispatch, invoicing and payment into one operational record.

data.value: Create shipments, follow their status and keep parcels, charges and history together.

data.name: public.home.module.parcels.text
data.value: Every parcel movement is a scan with a time and a place, so nothing is reconciled by hand.

data.name: public.home.module.dispatch.text
data.value: Group parcels into bundles, plan route legs and move them through dispatch with a clear view.

data.name: public.home.module.warehouse.text
data.value: Receiving, staging and routing, in one warehouse or many.

data.name: public.home.module.billing.text
data.value: Invoices come from shipment activity; payments stay linked to the work they pay for.

data.name: public.home.module.tenants.text
data.value: Each company works in its own space with its own users, roles and data, never visible to others.
